name: minimal-durability-kernel-candidate
principle: Bring forward only the durability invariants that make agent work recoverable, attributable, and replay-safe NOW on the existing runtime (observability.db + bd + git + shipped forensic v1). None of these requires the substrate daemon/state-store programme as a prerequisite. Each item cites its canonical source so the full substrate design can later absorb it without semantic drift.

items.name: Stable IDs
items.content: Colon-separated stable identifiers (chain:<id>, node:<id>, epic:<id>, pair:<uuid>); hierarchical sub-scopes with /. Container ID == its channel workstream ID so they cannot drift.
items.status_now: already de-facto used by bridge work and channels design
items.bring_forward_as: naming/identity convention enforced in current runtime tables

items.name: ChainRun / Container identity with three axes
items.content: Minimal container record: {id, kind, state} plus membership parent_id (mutable structural), provenance opened_by/opened_reason/origin_chain (immutable historical), ownership owned_by (mutable responsible-actor-now). Provenance chain to root reconstructible by following opened_by.
items.status_now: chain identity today is worktree-rooted lineage; formalize the record
items.bring_forward_as: a containers-shaped table or bd-molecule-backed view with the three axes

items.name: Participant / activation lineage (L3 vs L4)
items.content: participant_id stable per (scope, role) across re-activations; job_id new per activation/run; L1 kind / L2 role are the only label-safe identity fields; two activations of same role+scope = same participant_id, distinct job_id.
items.status_now: already adopted bridge-side by forensic-event-contract (shipped) and roadmap Opp 18
items.bring_forward_as: persist participant_id alongside job_id in job/event rows (forensic v1 already carries it)

items.name: Append-only effect receipts (idempotency keys)
items.content: Every external effect gated on a stable idempotency key before execution; replay re-checks and skips committed effects. Canonical key list: resume intent (channel_id,msg_id,target); system.* emission; forensic write (deterministic event id); evidence write (content-addressed); edge derivation UNIQUE(...); projection watermark; judge timeout.
items.status_now: pattern shipped for pulse dedup conceptually; not yet uniform
items.bring_forward_as: uniform receipts table or per-domain unique constraints in observability.db

items.name: Forensic dual-write through one envelope writer
items.content: Significant mutations emit xtrm.forensic.v1 events via the shared envelope writer; mechanical vs domain families kept separate; no caller hand-builds event JSON; forensics are audit facts only, never authority.
items.canonical_source: channels.md §10.5; substrate_design_it.md §2.8; SSOT telemetry/forensic-event-contract.md (SHIPPED in specialists repo)
items.bring_forward_as: keep shipping; extend adoption to channel/container mutations

items.name: Execution lineage: evidence as the durable side of live/persisted dual-write
items.content: A result is written live (channel/stream) AND persisted durably (evidence refs: diff ref, verdict ref, test ref, checklist) keyed by issue/step; tracing never depends on a stream surviving. Journal-with-state-snapshot-and-gap-detection pattern for any long-running actor (checkpoint cadence: persist at checkpoints, not clean exit).
items.status_now: specialist_results persists verbose output; structured evidence_json not yet materialized
items.bring_forward_as: structured evidence records attached to beads/jobs at completion

items.name: Projections recomputable from an append-only truth stream
items.content: Truth is the stream; every projection/cache is a pure fold over (stream + durable edges) recomputable from a watermark; monotonic cursor changesSince(cursor) is the read surface contract.
items.status_now: container_progress designed; observability.db already append-only events
items.bring_forward_as: watermark discipline on any derived state built now

items.name: Explicit uncertain / degraded state is recorded, never silently dropped
items.content: failure_class transient|semantic carried on failures; escalated suspension state preserves worktree+evidence; degrade-not-reject outcomes persisted (edge provenance unverified_endpoint, closed:with_followups flag, coordinator_release_missing fallback reason).
items.canonical_source: substrate_design_it.md §5.10, §6.10.1 resolution, §4.3 role-4 resolution; channels.md §5.8 endpoint validation
items.status_now: absent — failures today are prose in reports
items.bring_forward_as: failure_class + degraded-outcome fields on job/chain close records

items.name: Replay-safe recovery: never destroy work on failure
items.content: Destruction of worktrees/diffs/findings is always a deliberate decision (abandoned), never a side effect; failed runs preserve evidence for resume (transient) or improvement (semantic); reducer-pure/effect-in-after-hook split so crash-recovery replays never double-fire.
items.status_now: worktrees preserved by operator discipline; not runtime-guaranteed
items.bring_forward_as: preserve-on-failure rule in run/chain teardown paths

items.name: Backup-before-migration + integrity-check rollback predicate
items.content: Before destructive schema/migration steps: WAL checkpoint, hot-copy backup under exclusive lock; post-step PRAGMA integrity_check + foreign_key_check must be clean or rollback path engages; backups immutable; rollback requires operator approval and writes a migration.rollback forensic event.
items.canonical_source: state-store-options.md §10.2 (kernel-side authoritative version of substrate §13.8 Stage 0 gate)
items.status_now: not implemented anywhere; pattern applies to any store migration done now

explicitly_not_in_kernel: substrate daemon + Unix socket + state.db (Stage 0 programme)

constraint: Premortem R2 freeze rule: no new architectural section absorbs into canon without merged-PR runtime receipt; R9: non-author reviewer sign-off required. The kernel must ship as runtime behavior/receipts, not as new doc sections ahead of implementation.
